site.title: satloot
site.tagline: 交易风控、链上实验、小游戏与工具，一个人做的一堆东西
site.taglineEn: Trading tools, on-chain experiments, tiny games and utilities. Built by one person.

sites.title: BNBBANG 镜像宇宙
sites.desc: 每个 BNB 区块哈希都是一个宇宙：免费引爆随便看，喜欢再铸成 NFT，一个哈希只铸一次。推导引擎与经济模型开源，任何人可复算并对链验证。
sites.descEn: Every BNB block hash is a universe: detonate for free and look around, mint the ones you like as NFTs, one mint per hash. The derivation engine and economic model are open source, so anyone can recompute and verify against the chain.

sites.title: BTCBANG 比特宇宙
sites.desc: 每个比特币主网区块都是一个宇宙：十分钟一个新哈希，免费引爆，满 6 个确认再铸。铸进 BNBBANG 同一个合约、发同一个 BANG，不发新币。
sites.descEn: Every Bitcoin mainnet block is a universe: a new hash every ten minutes, free to detonate, mintable after 6 confirmations. It mints into the same BNBBANG contract and pays the same BANG — no new token.

sites.title: riskdesk 风控面板
sites.desc: 加密货币市场扫描与交易风控：异动雷达、相对强弱、资金费率、空投与新币投研、链上 meme 监控、交易纪律工具。注册即可看全部市场页。
sites.descEn: Crypto market scanning and trading risk control: anomaly radar, relative strength, funding rates, airdrop and new-coin research, on-chain meme monitoring, trading-discipline tools. Sign up to see every market page.

sites.title: 合约模拟器 Futures Trainer
sites.desc: USDⓈ-M 永续合约模拟器：接真实行情、用模拟资金下单，逐仓/全仓、条件单、追踪委托，强平价按交易所公式算，还有交易行为分析。不涉及任何真实资金。
sites.descEn: USDⓈ-M perpetual futures simulator: live market data, paper money, isolated/cross margin, conditional and trailing orders, liquidation price by the exchange formula, plus trading-behavior analysis. No real funds involved.

sites.title: 空投雷达
sites.desc: 进行中的加密空投项目一览：链、参与方式、阶段、热度证据与风险，按项目去重并标注首次发现日期；另有 BTT 山寨板新帖与 AI 中文速览，每 5 分钟同步。
sites.descEn: Ongoing crypto airdrops at a glance: chain, how to take part, stage, buzz evidence and risks, de-duplicated per project with first-seen dates. Plus new Bitcointalk altcoin announcements with AI summaries. Synced every 5 minutes.

sites.title: satloot 游戏厅
sites.desc: GitHub 上的小游戏，全部单文件、零依赖、打开即玩：3D 跑酷、卡丁车、美食大冒险、俄罗斯方块、水果消消乐。
sites.descEn: Tiny games from GitHub, all single-file, zero-dependency, playable instantly: 3D runner, kart racing, food adventure, Tetris, fruit match-3.

sites.title: satloot 工具站
sites.desc: 客户端下载入口：行情、资金、监控与研究工具在 iOS、Android、Windows、macOS 保持同步。
sites.descEn: Client download hub: market, funds, monitoring and research tools kept in sync across iOS, Android, Windows and macOS.

sites.title: 比特币测试网水龙头
sites.desc: 自建 testnet3 水龙头：中英双语、工作量证明加九层防滥用、可自定领取额、链上出账实时可查。
sites.descEn: Self-hosted testnet3 faucet: bilingual, proof-of-work plus nine anti-abuse layers, custom claim amounts, live on-chain payout feed.

sites.title: TRX 质押收益计算器
sites.desc: 自动读取搜狐能量频道最新能量 / 带宽收购价，叠加超级代表投票年化，四类产品每个档位的真实年化一表看全；TRX 实时价、链上押比、微信关口提醒，数字都能自己填。
sites.descEn: Reads the latest SOHU energy / bandwidth buy-back prices from Telegram, adds Super Representative vote APR, and shows the real yield of every tier; live TRX price, on-chain ratios, WeChat level alerts, every number editable.

private.name: riskdesk
private.desc: earn.satloot.com 背后的市场扫描与风控引擎，Vite + Node 侧车。
private.descEn: The market-scanning and risk engine behind earn.satloot.com, Vite + Node sidecar.

private.name: realkline
private.desc: 逐笔成交拼出来的真实 K 线，不用交易所聚合线。
private.descEn: Real candles rebuilt from tick-by-tick trades instead of exchange-aggregated klines.

private.name: mirror-universe
private.desc: 镜像宇宙模拟器：设定创世参数，引爆，走进那个宇宙看看。BNBBANG 的前身。
private.descEn: Mirror universe simulator: set genesis parameters, detonate, walk into that universe. The precursor of BNBBANG.

private.name: lootchain
private.desc: 用 OP_RETURN 锚定到比特币的 PoW 链：NarrowNet PoW、抽样验证与实验性 race 共识。
private.descEn: A PoW chain anchored to Bitcoin via OP_RETURN: NarrowNet PoW, sampled verification and an experimental race consensus.

private.name: kr-volume-radar
private.desc: Upbit / Bithumb 全市场放量扫描，每天两次，微信推送。
private.descEn: Full-market volume-surge scan on Upbit / Bithumb, twice a day, pushed to WeChat.

private.name: tuanzi 系列
private.desc: 团子 3D 跑酷、卡丁车、美食大冒险、俄罗斯方块、水果消消乐，五个单文件游戏仓库。
private.descEn: Tuanzi 3D runner, kart racing, food adventure, Tetris and fruit match-3: five single-file game repos.

repoDesc.bnbbang-economy: BNBBANG 经济模型：代币分配、签名协议（v1 / v2，含真实验证向量）与加固后的合约源码。

repoDescEn.futures-trainer: Perpetual futures simulator: live market data plus paper money, with exchange-grade liquidation math and trading-behavior analysis.
repoDescEn.satloot-tool: Landing page for tool.satloot.com: single file, zero dependencies, inline SVG.
repoDescEn.airdrop-site: Static site for airdrop.satloot.com: regenerated every 5 minutes from the riskdesk sidecar and a Bitcointalk monitor.
repoDescEn.satloot-home: satloot.com overview page: links every live site, public GitHub repo and work in progress. Pure static generation.
repoDescEn.gamehub: game.satloot.com arcade: pulls single-file games from GitHub and generates a cover page plus /play/ shells. Pure static.
repoDescEn.autofish: Delta Force auto-fishing: listens for the bite sound, reads on-screen hints with OCR, clicks only when the game is in the foreground.
repoDescEn.bnbbang-economy: BNBBANG economics: token allocation, signature protocol (v1 / v2 with real test vectors) and the hardened contract source.
repoDescEn.bnbbang-engine: BNBBANG derivation engine: BNB block hash → physical constants of a universe. Anyone can recompute and verify against the chain (AGPL-3.0).
repoDescEn.mirror-universe-engine: Mirror universe engine: a zero-dependency JS physics kernel for cosmic evolution. Feed it a set of fundamental constants and it computes how that universe ends.
repoDescEn.earnfarm: Cross-exchange funding-rate arbitrage tool: net APR ranking, historical decay modeling, automatic retreat when a leg is left naked.
repoDescEn.short-killer: Binance futures open-restriction sentinel: watches for the moment trapped shorts get their door opened.
repoDescEn.-YY-: WoW Classic: a list of scam raid-group YY channels.
